# Los Angeles Times

> > The Los Angeles Times is Southern California's leading news source, providing comprehensive coverage of local, national, and international news, with extensive archives documenting the region's cultural and political history.

The LA Times has been chronicling California and Los Angeles history since 1881, maintaining a rich archive of obituaries, political coverage, sports, arts reviews, and breaking news. The publication has documented pivotal moments in California politics under governors like Edmund G. Brown Jr. and George Deukmejian, as well as the lives of cultural icons from jazz legends to comedy pioneers.

## Key Topics

- Los Angeles history and culture
- California politics and government
- Obituaries and historical figures
- 1980s news archives
- Jazz and music history
- Southern California landmarks (Watts Towers)
- Sacramento political scene
- First ladies and political spouses
- Sports coverage and high school athletics
- Entertainment and arts criticism
- International news and humanitarian crises
- Business and automotive industry
- Legal and court proceedings
- Community news and local events

## Obituaries and Historical Figures

- [From the Archives: Groucho Marx Dies; Kept Them Laughing 65 Years](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-groucho-marx-19770820-snap-story.html): Obituary of Groucho Marx, legendary comedian and Marx Brothers star
- [From the Archives: Count Basie, 79, Master of Understated Swing, Dies](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-count-basie-1984-04-27-story.html): Obituary of Count Basie, legendary jazz pianist and big band leader
- [From the Archives: Lou Costello, Famed Comedian, Dies at 52](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/la-me-lou-costello-19590304-story.html): Obituary of Lou Costello, half of Abbott and Costello comedy duo
- [From the Archives: Renowed Jazz Bassist Charles Mingus Dies at 56](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-charles-mingus-19790108-story.html): Obituary of jazz legend Charles Mingus, bassist and composer
- [From the Archives: Wiley Manuel, First Black on State High Court, Dies](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-wiley-manuel-19810106-story.html): Obituary of Wiley Manuel, first Black California Supreme Court justice
- [From the Archives: Simon Rodia, 90, Builder of Famed Watts Towers, Dies in Martinez](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-simon-rodia-19650719-story.html): Obituary of Simon Rodia, Italian builder of iconic Watts Towers monument

## California Politics and Government

- [Keeping a Low Profile With 'First Lady Who?' : Gloria Deukmejian, Perceived as Traditional Wife, Juggles Politics and Family](https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1985-01-13-vw-9094-story.html): Profile of Gloria Deukmejian, California's low-profile first lady
- [Anti-Abortion Minister, Backers Fined](https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1985-01-24-me-11418-story.html): Santee minister Dorman Owens fined for violating abortion clinic order
